Name: Quick Cast Hotkeys (Smart Casting Key binding) No longer maintained
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

Adds other hotkeys to use toolbar items/tools. You don't have to swap then use you can just directly use the tool/item by directly pressing your assign hotkeys.

Also, now if you set a hotkey the Vanilla normal functions for that hotkey is suppressed to ensure your hotkey works. 

[*]You can customize the hotkeys for both keyboard and controller.[/*]
[*]It works with all tools, including charged tools like the watering can, hoe, and fishing rod.[/*]
[*]If used on food, it will trigger the "Do you want to eat this?" prompt before switching back.[/*]
[*]It doesn’t interfere with Stardew Valley’s default controls, so pick hotkeys that aren’t already used in the game.
